Lane brief

# Standing rules for every dispatched lane (read fully before the first tool call)
Dependencies and DI: every dependency is declared in the contract and injected.
No literal: no host, port, topic, model name, timeout or URL in changed source.
Two overlays: a falsifier runs the in-memory default and the broker overlay with no code change.
No Plugin class: no class named Plugin* in a node package.
No envelope in compute: a compute handler returns its typed result, never an envelope.
Zero literal: the literal validators report zero on the changed files.
Open PR: a PR is opened as a draft against the landing branch.
A check met at commit time costs a rewrite instead of at design time.

Task follows.
